CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageEnabled.Name: Enable Damage Advantage
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageEnabled.Hint: Master switch. Turn this off to stop the module touching any roll, including per-character effects. Leave it on and use the switch below for normal play.
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageGlobal.Name: Apply to Every Actor
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageGlobal.Hint: While on, every actor in the world - player characters, NPCs and monsters alike - rolls the damage types below twice and keeps the higher total. No effect needs adding to anyone. Also toggleable from the skull button in the token controls.
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageTypes.Name: Damage Types
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageTypes.Hint: Which damage types the enhancements below apply to. Separate several with commas, e.g. necrotic,radiant. Any dnd5e damage type key.
CGM.Settings.DamageMinimum.Name: Minimum Damage Die
CGM.Settings.DamageMinimum.Hint: While on, every damage die of the types above counts as at least the value below. Independent of the roll-twice switch - either, both or neither can run. Also toggleable from the die button in the token controls.
CGM.Settings.DamageMinimumValue.Name: Minimum Die Value
CGM.Settings.DamageMinimumValue.Hint: The floor under each damage die. 3 means any 1 or 2 counts as a 3.
CGM.Settings.Dome.Name: The Dome
CGM.Settings.Dome.Hint: While the Dome is up, leveled spells and short rests roll on its tables. Healing spells roll on the healing table, necromancy spells on the necromancy table, every other leveled spell on the wild magic table, and each character finishing a short rest on the rest mutation table. Cantrips are exempt. Also toggleable from the dome button in the token controls.
CGM.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug Logging
CGM.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log each roll this module modifies to the console for troubleshooting.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.AnnounceOnDetail: Every actor now rolls {types} damage twice and keeps the higher total.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.AnnounceMasterOff: The module's master switch is off, so nothing will actually change until it is turned back on in Module Settings.
CGM.DamageMinimum.AnnounceOnDetail: Any roll of {below} or lower on a {types} damage die now counts as {minimum}.
CGM.Dome.Name: The Dome
CGM.Dome.AnnounceOnDetail: Leveled spells and short rests now roll on the Dome's tables. Cantrips are unaffected.
CGM.Dome.NoResult: The Dome stirs, but nothing comes of it.
CGM.Dome.MissingTable: {module} could not find the Dome's "{trigger}" table. Check that the module's compendium is available.
CGM.Dome.Error: {module} failed to roll on a Dome table. See the console for details.
CGM.Dome.ApplyFailed: {module} rolled the Dome table but could not apply the result automatically. Apply it by hand. See the console for details.
CGM.Dome.GMOnly: Only a GM can raise or lower the Dome.
CGM.Dome.TestHint: Click a face to roll that exact result on the selected token. The result is applied for real, so use a test character. Automated results apply themselves; manual ones state a rule Foundry cannot enforce; cosmetic ones are flavour only.
CGM.Dome.TestNoActor: Select a token, or assign yourself a character, before testing a Dome result.
CGM.Dome.TestNoTables: No Dome tables could be loaded. Check that the module's compendium is available.
CGM.Dome.TestFailed: Testing face {face} failed. See the console for details.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.GMOnly: Only a GM can change the world-wide damage switches.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.Error: {module} failed to apply damage advantage to this roll. The roll itself is unaffected. See the console for details.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.NoActor: Select a token or pass an actor to toggle damage advantage.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.NotOwner: You do not have permission to change effects on {name}.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.NoType: No damage type given, and no damage types are configured.
